name: Keck Medicine of USC Summer Youth Volunteer Program
org: Keck Medicine of USC, Office of Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Volunteer for 8 weeks in summer. You work at Keck Hospital of USC or USC Norris Cancer Hospital.
who_can_apply: Currently enrolled high school students ages 16 to 17. Must be 16 or older when you apply.
duration: 8 weeks, at least 8 hours a week and 60 hours total
deadline_text: The page lists the application period as Feb 1 to April 30, with recommendation letters due April 30 (year not stated). Orientation is the second week of June.
how_to_apply: Apply online. You need a self-portrait photo, proof of COVID-19 vaccination and a questionnaire. Recommenders email letters to volunteer@med.usc.edu by April 30. If accepted, you do an interview. Then you get a health screening with a TB test, an orientation and a tour. Phone (323) 442-8436.
notes: Check the page in January for the next year's dates.
